Keeps the processor running with the screen off so keepalive timers fire on time. The most reliable setting; uses more battery. Only held while you are signed in to campus Wi-Fi.

Only runs when you tap the button. It asks GitHub for the latest release and sends no accounts or personal data. Nothing is installed automatically.
UniLink can only sign in over campus Wi-Fi. Android does not let apps switch Wi-Fi on by themselves, so tap the button and flip the Wi-Fi switch.
Data usage not fetched yet. Tap Refresh.
Tap to open the download page.
Once a day UniLink asks GitHub for the latest version and shows one quiet notice only if yours is older. Nothing is installed and no account data is sent.
Every account on %1$s is out of data, disabled or has a wrong password. Tap to review them.
Sign in with the account that has the most data left (needs a recent Refresh data usage). Accounts under 200 MB are tried last. Off: use the list order.
Tell me when no account works
One quiet notification when every account is out of data, disabled or rejected. It is shown once until a sign-in works again.
UniLink signs in to your university Wi-Fi and keeps you connected, even with the screen off or a VPN running. This short tour shows what to do. You can skip it at any time.
Open the Accounts tab and tap + to add a student number and password. Add several and UniLink switches to the next one when an account runs out of data.
The first time, a certificate card appears on the Connection tab. Compare its fingerprint with the one your browser shows on the normal login page, then tap Trust. No password is sent before you do.
The Connection tab shows your status and a bar with the data you have left. After that UniLink signs in by itself on campus Wi-Fi. Use Connect to sign in now, or Pause & sign out to stop.
Tap Refresh data usage on the Accounts tab to read each account\'s remaining data from the university portal. Settings has Most data first, which uses it to pick the best account.
Let it run in the background
Allow Location (Android needs it to read the Wi-Fi name), Notifications and Unrestricted battery. Settings has a step-by-step battery guide for your phone brand.
Some phones stop background apps to save battery, so UniLink misses keepalives and you go offline. Open your phone brand and follow the steps.
Menu names differ a little between Android versions. If you cannot find an entry, search for Battery in Settings.

1. Settings → Apps → UniLink → Battery → choose Unrestricted.\n2. Settings → Battery → Background usage limits: turn off Put unused apps to sleep, and make sure UniLink is not in the Sleeping apps or Deep sleeping apps lists (add it to Never sleeping apps).\n3. Open Recent apps, tap the UniLink icon at the top and choose Keep open.

1. Settings → Apps → Manage apps → UniLink → Battery saver → No restrictions.
2. On the same page turn on Autostart.
3. Open Recent apps, press and hold the UniLink card and tap the lock icon so it is not cleared.
4. Settings → Battery: turn off any battery saver that limits background apps.

1. Settings → Battery → App launch → UniLink: turn off Manage automatically.\n2. Turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.\n3. Settings → Apps → UniLink → Battery: allow it to run in the background (Unrestricted).

1. Settings → Battery → UniLink (or More battery settings → App battery management) → Allow background activity.\n2. Settings → Apps → App management → UniLink: turn on Auto launch (Allow auto-start).\n3. Open Recent apps and lock the UniLink card.
1. Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → UniLink → Allow high background power consumption.\n2. Settings → Apps → Autostart: turn UniLink on.\n3. Lock UniLink in Recent apps.

1. Settings → Apps → UniLink → App battery usage (or Battery) → Unrestricted.\n2. If your phone has Adaptive Battery or a battery optimisation list, make sure UniLink is not optimised.\n3. Turn off Battery saver while you rely on UniLink, or add UniLink as an exception.
The portal rejected the password of %1$s, so UniLink skips it. Edit the account to use it again.
The portal rejected its password. Edit the account on the Accounts tab, or pick another one.
Its data allowance is used up this month. Pick another account.
The account is switched off. Turn it on in the Accounts tab.
Switch right after choosing an account
Tapping Use this account signs out of the current one, signs in with it and opens the Connection tab. When off, it only makes it the default.
